EVOKE Photography & Video

$1,650 package

Houston wedding photo and video team documenting Greater Houston weddings since 1999. The site says the team has covered more than 6,000 weddings and that wedding work is all they do.

The photo package starts at $1,650 and the video package starts at $1,950. The page lists hours of coverage, digital files, print rights, an engagement session, and galleries inside the photo package, without stating the hour count next to the price. · Source · checked 2026-10-03 · published
